name: Wetter (Ruhr, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Wetter (Ruhr) (a crenellated letter W above a chequy bar and a lily on yellow).
history: The crenellated letter is the initial of the place name and an allusion to the castles of Wetter and Volmarstein; the hoisted flag is divided red and white with the city arms at the centre, and flags and banners without arms are also used.

features.role: Wetter arms — crenellated W, chequy bar and lily
